source: none: from-scratch unit (sheet design/reference/fogeist-character-sheet.png, measured on fogeist-character-sheet-row.png)
units: sheet units: 1 unit = 100 FRONT-view px; side mapped at SIDE_K 1.34 (body / crest / tail) and HEAD_K 1.08 (head profile); floor z = 0 at the puddle bottom

facing.rule: head centre at eye height -> the midpoint of the two eyes (the face looks -Y)

tier_rationale: REGULAR role (a line unit): window [8000, 22000]. One smooth mist shell carries the whole budget (soft rounded lobes need density to read round under flat shading; the crest is the largest surface); the face zone is densified for the eye outlines.

open_edges.rule: one closed SDF shell (the wisps are closed tubes smooth-unioned into it)

sheet_deviations: SCALE: the side view is mapped at SIDE_K 1.34 (eye-centre height above the floor 2.382 / 1.78 and crest top 3.95 / 2.95); the side's HEAD is not drawn 1.34x (head top->chin x0.92, eye height x0.83, head top->eye x0.85), so the head is built at the front's size with its side profile at HEAD_K 1.08 -- in the side ortho the head reads ~1.2-1.5x the sheet's and the whole side row does not overlay 1:1 (by design: the front / back fix the scale)
HEAD TOP: front 2.69 (hood top y 209) vs side at SIDE_K 2.35 (y 165): built 2.69 (front)
SNOUT: the side draws the eye 0.335 u (31 px x HEAD_K) behind the snout front; on the built head (front-view eye spacing on a 0.60-wide head) the eye lands ~0.18 u behind it
HOOD FLAPS: front bottom z 1.45 (y 333) vs side ~1.27 at SIDE_K (y 309): built 1.42 (front)

CREST DRIFT: the front view biases the crest to image right (+X: -1.83 / +2.40 at z 1.58) while the back view (a rear three-quarter) streams it ~3.7 u to image right (-X): contradictory lateral drift -> built straight back (+Y, the side view's direction) and SYMMETRIC (half-widths averaged); lateral wisps mirrored

BACK VIEW: drawn as a rear three-quarter (crest + tail run off to image right), not a true ortho: used for heights (crest top 2.90) and the body's back width (~0.97 half) only; no back-view overlay row exists (intake ortho_frame views = front, side)
TAIL WIDTH: no true view draws it (hidden behind the puddle in front; 3/4 in back): tapered 0.95 -> 0.34 half-width from the back view's body width

WISPS: closed lobed blobs (chains of flattened tapering ellipsoids, smooth-unioned), not volumetrics; the sheet's many fine curling strands are reduced to 8 lumpy blob strands (3 crest-end, 5 tail incl. mirrored pairs)

FRONT LATERAL WISPS: the front view's image-left low wisps (x 107-122, y 380-450) and image-right trailing wisps (x 456-612) are not modelled as strands (they read as horns in a first pass); the crest's low wings carry the front view's width (~2.1 half at z 1.4-1.8)
LIGHTING: the sheet lights the crest brighter on image right (front crest R 163 vs L 118); tones are painted symmetric (height / facing only)
EYES: simple dark ovals (chip 55,66,82); the sheet's soft reflection band inside each eye and the paler halo round it are not modelled
INK LINES: the thin contour lines (hood edge, chest / haunch outlines) are not modelled (brief)

TRANSLUCENCY: per-region alpha (crest_lit 0.80 / crest 0.72 / crest_deep 0.60 / wisp 0.50) on a closed shell, one blended layer: the sheet's soft feathered wisp edges are hard silhouette edges here; the mist casts a solid (not see-through) shadow

bake.cage_rule: 3 x the shell high->low sampled p99 distance (floor BAKE_CAGE_FLOOR 0.04)
bake.normal_reference: FLAT low faces (the mist reads smooth under the flat_shaded contract); wired into both materials

palette.provenance: pixel-sampled from the sheet's five palette chips + drawn-surface samples (see the palette notes)
